info.title: Token Controller API
info.description: The versioned REST API of Token Controller. Everything the web app does goes through it. See docs.tokencontroller.com/reference/api.

get.summary:
Your API tokens and CLI tokens, or every one in the organization for a
controller.

post.summary:
Create an API token. Anyone can create service and read tokens for
themselves; only a controller creates the organization token.

delete.summary: Revoke an API token or a CLI token: your own, or any as a controller.

post.summary:
Hand a service token over to another member, for example when its
creator leaves. Only future token entries follow. Its owner or a
controller can do this.

get.summary: The bill sources the organization connected. Controllers only.

post.summary:
Connect a bill source with an admin key. Controllers only. The first
pull starts right away and loads the current and the previous period.

400.description: The key is missing

delete.summary:
Disconnect a bill source. Controllers only. Its bills stay, and stop
updating.

post.summary:
Pull a bill source's bills now instead of at its next daily pull.
Controllers only.

202.description: The pull starts within a minute

get.summary: The latest revision of every bill, newest period first.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The bills, as JSON or CSV

403.description: Only a controller can read bills

post.summary: Send a bill for a period.
post.description:
Stores a new revision when the figures differ from the latest one, and
answers 200 with the unchanged bill when they do not.

200.description: The same figures were already stored

400.description: The figures cannot be read or do not add up

403.description: Only a controller can send bills

post.summary:
Upload a CSV bill file. Every bill in it is checked before any is
stored, so a file with a problem saves nothing. Each bill is stored as a
new revision when its figures differ from the latest one. Controllers
only.

parameters.name: cloud
parameters.description:
The cloud whose own cost export this is: `bedrock`, `vertex` or
`foundry`. Left out, the file is in the bill schema's columns.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period a cloud's export is the bill for, such as `2026-09`.

400.description: The file has a problem; nothing was saved

403.description: Only a controller can upload bills

post.summary:
Read a CSV bill file and show the bills it holds, or the first problem
in it with its row and column. Saves nothing. Controllers only.

parameters.name: cloud
parameters.description:
The cloud whose own cost export this is: `bedrock`, `vertex` or
`foundry`. Left out, the file is in the bill schema's columns.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period a cloud's export is the bill for, such as `2026-09`.

403.description: Only a controller can upload bills

get.summary: Every revision of one bill, oldest first.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The bill's revisions, as JSON or CSV

get.summary: The cadences of the organization and its projects.

200.description: The cadences

put.summary:
Set the cadence of the organization or of one project. A people manager
sets a project's cadence within the filters they are assigned.

200.description: The cadence in force

400.description: The cadence is not valid

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

delete.summary: Remove a cadence: its token sheets are no longer due.

get.summary:
The clients: values of the `client` tag on projects, with their
projects. Cost per client is a filter on this tag.

delete.summary: Revoke a link: it stops working at once.

get.summary:
Everything the organization has, as a zip of JSON files. Controllers
only.

200.description: A zip of JSON files

get.summary: Is the service up and can it reach its database?

200.description: The service works

post.summary:
OTLP logs: one model call per event, for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini
CLI and Cursor. Takes the organization token.

requestBody.description: An OTLP ExportLogsServiceRequest, as protobuf or JSON, optionally gzip-compressed

200.description: An OTLP ExportLogsServiceResponse

post.summary:
OTLP metrics: accepted and not counted, because the events already count
every model call. Takes the organization token.

requestBody.description: An OTLP ExportMetricsServiceRequest, as protobuf or JSON, optionally gzip-compressed

200.description: An OTLP ExportMetricsServiceResponse

post.summary:
OTLP traces: one model call per chat span, for Copilot CLI. Takes the
organization token.

requestBody.description: An OTLP ExportTraceServiceRequest, as protobuf or JSON, optionally gzip-compressed

200.description: An OTLP ExportTraceServiceResponse

get.summary:
What an invite link is for, before the person signs in: the page fills
in the email and asks for a sign-in link.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The part after /i/ in the invite link

post.summary: The MCP endpoint. Send JSON-RPC messages with a read token or a session.

requestBody.description: A JSON-RPC 2.0 message of the Model Context Protocol

200.description: The JSON-RPC answer

get.summary: The signed-in person and their organization.

What a local tool needs to place token entries the way the service
does: the organization's rules and tag names, your own rules and tags,
and the projects with their ticket key patterns and repositories.
Your own rules, in order. They run after the organization's.

put.summary: Replace your own rules. They run after the organization's.

get.summary: Everyone in the organization.

post.summary:
Invite someone by email. They get a link that signs them in. Controllers
only.

409.description: Already a member, or the member limit is reached

delete.summary:
Remove a member. They can no longer sign in; their past token entries
keep them as agent manager, and their service tokens wait for a new
owner. Controllers only.

409.description: The organization would have no controller

patch.summary: Change a member's name, role or tags. Controllers only.

409.description: The organization would have no controller

put.summary:
Assign a people manager the filters they read and approve, such as
`{"team": "web"}` and `{"client": "acme"}`. Replaces their filters.
Controllers only.

post.summary:
Send the invite mail again to someone who has not signed in yet.
Controllers only.

409.description: They already signed in

get.summary: The organization's settings.

patch.summary: Change the organization's settings. Controllers only.

get.summary: The organization's member count and member limit.
The organization's rules and how they place token entries.

put.summary: Change the organization's rules. Controllers only.

get.summary:
Every period from the first with a token entry or a bill up to this
month, newest first. Everyone can list them, to pick a period.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The periods, as JSON or CSV

get.summary: One period and what is still open in it.

200.description: The period

409.description: An exchange rate is missing

post.summary: Post a signed correction to a closed period.

201.description: Posted; the cost sheet with it

400.description: The amount or reason is missing

409.description: The period is not closed

post.summary:
Close a period: lock its token entries and keep the tag map, price table
and bills it closed with. Answers with the cost sheet.

200.description: Closed; the cost sheet

403.description: Only a controller can close a period

409.description: The period cannot close yet; the message says why

get.summary:
The cost sheet of a period: final once it is closed, a preview while it
is open.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Extra tag names as columns, comma-separated, such as `team,purpose`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for a CSV file; JSON otherwise.

200.description: The cost sheet, as JSON or CSV

409.description: An exchange rate is missing

get.summary: The links made for a period.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The links, newest first, as JSON or CSV

post.summary: Make a link that shows the cost sheet without signing in.

409.description: The period is not closed

get.summary: The organization's projects.

post.summary: Create a project. People managers and controllers.

409.description: The name or a repository is taken

delete.summary:
Archive a project. Its tickets and past token entries stay; its
repositories are freed for other projects. People managers and
controllers.

patch.summary: Change a project. People managers and controllers.

get.summary: Each bill of a period against its token entries, with residual.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: The period's reconciliation, as JSON or CSV

403.description: Only a controller can read the reconciliation

409.description: An exchange rate is missing

get.summary: Cost by agent harness, agent name, model, effort or speed.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show the report in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

400.description: `by` is not one of the agent harness cuts

get.summary:
Cost grouped by any tag, within a filter: the reporting API's main
report.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show the report in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

400.description: The filter, grouping or currency cannot be read

409.description: An exchange rate is missing

get.summary: Tickets that cost far more or less than similar past tickets.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Only tickets matching this tag filter, such as `client:acme`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many tickets to list, 20 when left out.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
`all` (the default) or `approved`: with approval on, only approved
token entries count, in the period and in the baseline.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show the amounts in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: The outliers, as JSON or CSV

400.description: The filter or currency cannot be read

409.description: An exchange rate is missing

get.summary: The saved reports of the organization, by name.

200.description: Saved reports

post.summary: Save a tag filter with a grouping as a report.

400.description: No name, no grouping, or a filter that cannot be read

get.summary: A saved report for one period.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show the report in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: The report, as JSON or CSV

delete.summary: Remove a saved report. Its creator or a controller can.

404.description: No such saved report of yours

get.summary:
Token budget vs actual: one row per token budget in force for the
period, with the token budget, the actual cost and the difference.
Token budgets overlap, so the rows are never added up.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: this month.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show money in another currency, such as `USD`.

200.description: Token budget vs actual, as JSON or CSV

400.description: The period is not valid

409.description: An exchange rate is missing

get.summary:
One token budget opened down to the tickets (by their `ticket` tag) and
token entries behind its actual, for a period it is in force in.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: this month.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Show money in another currency, such as `USD`.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description:
The table the CSV file holds: `tickets` (the default) or
`token_entries`.

200.description: The token budget's actual opened down, as JSON or CSV

400.description: The period or table is not valid

409.description: The token budget is not in force in the period, or an exchange rate is missing

get.summary:
Token entries with their splits, tags and summaries, within the caller's
role.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: all time.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Statuses, comma separated, out of `submitted`, `approved`,
`rejected` and `locked`. Left out: every status that counts.

parameters.name: person
parameters.description: Only this agent manager's token entries.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description:
`csv` for a CSV file of every matching token entry, one row per
split.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Token entries per page, up to 5000.

200.description: Token entries, as a JSON page or one CSV file

400.description: The filter or a status cannot be read

get.summary: The cost sheet behind a link, without signing in.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: The secret part of the link

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Extra tag names as columns, comma-separated, such as `team,purpose`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for a CSV file; JSON otherwise.

200.description: The cost sheet with the organization's name, as JSON or CSV

404.description: No such link, or it was revoked

post.summary: Send a sign-in link to a member.
post.description:
Always answers 202, so nobody learns whether an address is a member. An
address that belongs to no organization gets a mail that says so, with a
link to create one.

202.description: A mail is on its way

400.description: Not an email address

429.description: Too many links for this address

get.summary: The page a sign-in link opens: a "Sign in" button that posts the link.

200.description: The page with the Sign in button

410.description: The link was used, has expired or never existed

post.summary: Use a sign-in link: the form on the link's page posts here.
post.description:
A browser gets its session cookie and goes to the web app, after a
sign-up to its first steps. A local tool's link only marks the link
used; the tool collects its session with `POST /sign-in/poll`.

200.description: A local tool is signed in

303.description: Signed in; on to the web app

410.description: The link was used, has expired or never existed

post.summary: Collect a local tool's session after the person used the link.

200.description: Signed in. The session token comes only once

202.description: The link was not used yet; ask again in a few seconds

410.description: The link expired, or the session was already collected

get.summary:
The ways to sign in besides the magic link, for the buttons on the
sign-in page. Empty on the open edition.

post.summary: Sign out: ends the session in the cookie or the bearer token.
Create an organization and email its first controller a link.
post.description:
The organization exists once the link is used, in any browser. An
address that is already a member gets an ordinary sign-in link instead:
one account belongs to one organization.

202.description: A mail is on its way

400.description: Not an email address, no name, or not a currency

429.description: Too many links for this address

get.summary:
The address behind the link in the "no account" mail, for the web app's
sign-up form. Reading it uses nothing up.

410.description: The link was used, has expired, or cannot create an organization

post.summary:
Create an organization with the link from the "no account" mail. The
founder is signed in at once: the answer sets the session cookie, and
no second mail goes out.

204.description: Created and signed in; the session cookie is set

400.description: No name, or not a currency

410.description: The link was used, has expired, or cannot create an organization

get.summary: The state of every part status.tokencontroller.com shows.
The tag map in force.

put.summary:
Change the tag map. A new version is kept; closed periods keep theirs.
Controllers only.

get.summary: The organization's tag names.

post.summary: Add a tag name, such as `team` or `client`. Controllers only.

delete.summary:
Remove a tag name. People, projects, tickets and rules lose its values;
token entries keep theirs. Controllers only; not while the tag map uses it.

post.summary:
Merge values of a tag name into one, on people, projects, tickets,
people managers' filters and rules. Controllers only. The built-in names
cannot be merged: their values are members, projects and tickets.

200.description: The tag name's values after the merge

get.summary:
The values of one tag name on people, projects and tickets. For the
built-in names: the members' emails, the projects and the ticket keys.
The ticket systems the organization connected.

post.summary:
Connect a ticket system with an API token. Controllers only. The first
sync starts right away; whoever connects a ticket system answers for
that data flow.

400.description: The address or the token is not usable

delete.summary:
Disconnect a ticket system. Controllers only. Its tickets stay, and stop
syncing.

put.summary:
Set which projects of the ticket system feed which Token Controller
projects, replacing the earlier mapping. Controllers only. A project
without a ticket key pattern gets the one its tickets use, and a sync
starts right away.

400.description: A project is unknown or mapped twice

get.summary:
The projects the ticket system shows the token, to map. Controllers
only.

400.description: The ticket system refused the token or could not be read

post.summary:
Sync a ticket system now, without waiting for its 15 minutes. Controllers
only.

202.description: The sync starts within a minute

get.summary: The organization's tickets, by key.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of the key or the title.

post.summary: Create a ticket by hand, for work no ticket system knows. Any member.

409.description: A ticket with this key exists

get.summary: One ticket.

patch.summary:
Change a ticket. People managers and controllers; for tickets created by
hand, any member.

get.summary:
The latest token forecast made for a ticket, as it was made, with the
token budget it became once accepted.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The ticket key, such as KD-214

200.description: The latest token forecast

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

404.description: No token forecast was made for this ticket

post.summary:
Make a token forecast for a ticket from similar past work: its title
and description are compared with the summaries of past token entries,
and the median actual cost of the best-matching past tickets is
proposed. Nothing is planned until a person accepts it.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The ticket key, such as KD-214

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

409.description: Token forecasts are off on this instance or for this organization, the ticket has no text, or the model failed; the message says which

get.summary:
The token budgets you may see: a controller all of them, a people
manager those within their filters, an agent manager those on their own
person. They can overlap; never add them up.

200.description: The token budgets, as JSON or CSV

post.summary:
Set a token budget on a tag filter: for one period, every month from a
period on, or all time. People managers set them within the filters they
are assigned, controllers anywhere.

400.description: The filter, period or amount is not valid

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

put.summary:
Change a token budget. Both its old and its new filter must lie within
the filters you are assigned.

200.description: Changed

400.description: The filter, period or amount is not valid

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

delete.summary: Remove a token budget. It no longer shows in token budget vs actual.

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

post.summary:
Report token entries. With a service token they arrive automatically,
submitted, and the token's creator is their agent manager. Signed in,
they are manual entries on your own token sheet, as drafts. Sending one
again with the same `session_id` or `local_id` updates it.

400.description: A token entry breaks the schema; nothing was stored

409.description: A token entry is in a closed period; post an adjustment instead

get.summary:
Submitted token entries waiting for approval, within the caller's
filters.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: The period, such as `2026-09`. Left out: every open period.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: A tag filter in the URL form, such as `team:web,client:acme`.

200.description: Token entries waiting for approval, as JSON or CSV

post.summary: Approve submitted token entries, one by one or in bulk.

200.description: Approved

409.description: Approval is off

post.summary:
Import a CSV file of token entries onto your token sheet, as drafts.
Every row must be readable; otherwise nothing is saved.

400.description: A row cannot be read; nothing was saved

409.description: A row is in a closed period

post.summary:
Read a CSV file of token entries and show what it holds, with the
problem in each row that cannot be read. Saves nothing.

400.description: The file as a whole cannot be read

post.summary:
Send a token entry back to its agent manager with a reason. It does not
count until it is fixed and submitted again.

200.description: Rejected

400.description: A reason is needed

404.description: No such token entry within your filters

409.description: The token entry is in a closed period

put.summary:
Split one of your token entries by hand, such as one session for two
tickets at 60 and 40 percent.

200.description: The token entry, placed again

400.description: The shares do not add up to 100 percent

404.description: No such token entry of yours

409.description: Closed or approved

patch.summary:
Set the tags of one of your token entries by hand, such as its ticket.
It becomes one split again, placed by hand.

200.description: The token entry, placed again

400.description: A tag breaks the rules

404.description: No such token entry of yours

409.description: Closed or approved

get.summary:
Whether token forecasts are on for the organization and available on
this instance.

200.description: The token forecast settings

put.summary:
Switch token forecasts on or off for the organization. Token budgets
work either way.

200.description: The token forecast settings

403.description: Only a controller can switch token forecasts

post.summary:
Accept a token forecast: it becomes a token budget on its ticket for
all time. Keep only some matches, or type the amount instead.

400.description: The amount or a match is not valid

403.description: Outside the filters you are assigned

409.description: Already accepted, or there is no amount to accept

get.summary:
Your token sheet: drafts, token entries sent back with a reason, and
token entries whose ticket the ticket sync could not find, with the
cadence period and whether a token sheet is late.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: Your token sheet, or its token entries as CSV

get.summary:
Late token sheets: whose, and for which cadence period. A people manager
sees the people within their filters; an agent manager their own.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Only cadence periods overlapping this month, such as `2026-09`.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: `csv` for the table as a CSV file instead of JSON.

200.description: Late token sheets, oldest first, as JSON or CSV

post.summary:
Ask everyone to submit their token sheets for a month before the close,
the way finance asks for timesheets. The request shows in the web app
and to local tools until the month closes.

200.description: Asked

403.description: Only a controller can ask everyone

409.description: The month is closed

post.summary:
Submit your token sheet: the token entries reviewed on your machine,
and your drafts here. Submit whenever you like; an empty list says there
was nothing to report.

requestBody.description: Optional: the web app sends none

200.description: Submitted

400.description: A token entry breaks the schema; nothing was submitted

409.description: A token entry sent again is locked in a closed period

AcceptInput.description: How to accept a token forecast.

amount.description: Type the amount instead, in the reporting currency, such as `45.00`.

tickets.description:
Keep only these matches, by ticket key: the token budget is their
median cost. Left out: the proposal as it is.

AdjustmentInput.description: An adjustment to post (docs: Account > Adjustments).

amount.description: Plus or minus, in the reporting currency, such as `-120.00`.

reason.example: Provider credit for the September outage

tags.description:
The cost object and any other tags, such as `{"ticket": "KD-214"}`.
No tags puts it on the organization.

AdjustmentLine.description: An adjustment to a closed period that counts in actual.

late.description: Posted from a token sheet submitted after its period closed.

AdjustmentRow.description: An adjustment as the cost sheet shows it.

cost_kind.description: The cost kind its tags give.

late.description: Posted for a token sheet that came in after the close.

posted_by.description: Who posted it; `null` for a late token sheet, posted on its own.

ApiToken.description: An API token as lists show it, without its secret.

needs_owner.description:
The person left the organization. A service token in this state
needs a new owner; its token entries show as an error until then.

person_id.description:
The person it belongs to: for a service token, the agent manager of
everything it reports.

shown_prefix.description: The start of the token, such as `tc_svc_3f9a`.

ApproveInput.description:
Token entries to approve: by ID, or everything matching a filter and
period.

token_entry_ids.description:
These token entries. Left out: every submitted token entry matching
`period` and `filter` that the caller may approve.

AskedToSubmit.description: A controller asked everyone to submit before the close.

Baseline.description: What a ticket was compared with.

BillApi.description: The provider API a bill connection pulls from.

BillBlock.description: One bill's part of the cost sheet, in the reporting currency.

exchange_rate.description: From the bill's currency to the reporting currency.

BillCheck.description: One bill against the token entries it charges, in the bill's currency.

attribution_percent.description: The share of the gross that token entries explain, in percent.

bill.description:
The revision checked: the latest, or for a closed period the one it
closed with.

gross.description: The bill's gross, at list price before discount and credit.

residual.description:
Gross minus token entries: what no token entry explains. Negative
when token entries come to more than the bill.

token_entries.description: The list value of the token entries it charges.

token_entry_count.description: How many token entry splits were counted.

unknown_model_count.description:
Token entries on a model missing from the price table. Their cost is
unknown, so it sits in residual, never as zero.

BillConnectionView.description:
A connected bill source, as the web app shows it. The key is never sent
back.

key_hint.description: The key's last characters, to tell keys apart.

BillCostSource.description:
How a provider charges for what a bill covers: the metered cost sources.
Seats and subscriptions are flat fees and have no bill. When one
provider has bills from several cost sources, its token entries are
charged on the first in this order.

BillCsvBill.description: One bill as the file holds it.

lines.description: How many lines a cloud's export was summed from.

BillCsvPreview.description: What a CSV file holds, before anything is saved.

bills.description: The bills the file holds; empty when there is a problem.

oneOf.description: The first problem found. Nothing can be uploaded until it is fixed.

BillCsvProblem.description: What is wrong with the file, and where.

column.description: The column as the file names it.

message.description: What is wrong, in plain words.

row.description: The line in the file, counting the header as line 1.

bills.description: The latest revision of each bill in the file.

changed.description:
How many of them got a new revision; the rest were already stored
with the same figures.

BillInput.description:
A bill as the bills endpoint and the web app send it (docs: Reference >
Bill schema). Amounts are decimal strings in `currency`.

exchange_rate.description:
To the organization's reporting currency, at the bill's date. Left
out, Token Controller fills it in.

gross.description:
Before discount and credit. Left out, it is net plus discount plus
credit.

typed_in.description: Typed in by hand in the web app, rather than sent by a program.

BillSource.description: How a bill reached Token Controller.

exchange_rate.description:
To the reporting currency; `null` until a rate for the bill's date is
known.

exchange_rate_given.description:
Whether the rate came with the bill, rather than from the reference
rates.

final.description:
Whether the provider will no longer change these figures. The close
of the period waits for a bill that is not final.

revision.description: 1 for the first figure, higher after each restatement.

late.description: Whether an earlier cadence period still waits for its token sheet.

every_days.description:
For a custom cadence: the length of each cadence period in days,
from 1 to 366.

project.description: The project's name; left out for the whole organization.

starts_on.description:
The day the first cadence period starts. Left out: the Monday of
this week.

CadenceKind.description: How often token sheets are due.

CadencePeriod.description: One stretch of a cadence: from `starts_on` up to and including `ends_on`.

CadenceView.description: A cadence as the API shows it.

every_days.description: For a custom cadence: the length of each cadence period in days.

project.description: The project it is set for; `null` for the whole organization.

starts_on.description: The day the first cadence period starts.

Check.description: Whether one part of the service works.

Client.description: A client: a value of the `client` tag on projects.

Component.description: One part of the service, as status.tokencontroller.com lists them.

last_success_at.description: For a job: when it last succeeded.

ConnectionStatus.description: How a connection's last pull or sync went.

Context.description:
Everything a local tool needs to place token entries the way the service
does.

oneOf.description:
